title: Come into the ark (Genesis 7:1) and 'Come to Me' (Matthew 11:28)
summary: Genesis 7:1, where the LORD tells Noah to come with his whole house into the ark because he alone was seen righteous, shown beside Matthew 11:28, 'Come to Me, all who are weary and heavy-laden, and I will give you rest', signed yeshua ישוע Jesus; the word 'Come' and 'Me' are in red.

text.text: 1 Then the LORD said to Noah, “Come, you and all your house into the ark, for you alone I have seen to be righteous before Me in this time.
28 Come to Me, all who are weary and heavy-laden, and I will give you rest.

keywords: you alone I have seen righteous
uncertain: Colours not explained on the slide: 'Come' red in Genesis 7:1; 'LORD' letters brown/orange; 'No' of Noah green; 'Me' and 'I' red in Matthew 11:28. Greek header written as shown: Μαθθαῖον.
